name: Ettin 68M
description: Ettin encoder (Johns Hopkins, 68M parameters, 77 MB) fine-tuned to detect AI-written English text. Held-out AUROC (1 = perfect, 0.5 = chance): 0.980 on rewritten AI texts, 0.946 on GPT-4 texts from unseen domains, 0.898 on the newest models (TextSight 2026), 0.822 on paraphrased GPT-4 texts, 0.752 on edited chatbot answers (Beemo). Calibrated: 50% flags 5% of human texts (MAGE).
